answer.recommendation:
FAQ: Scheduled Exports

Q: What is scheduled exports?
A: Scheduled exports let you set up exports to run automatically, in CSV or JSON format. Launch date: November 4.

Q: Which file formats are supported?
A: CSV and JSON.

Q: How many rows can one export include?
A: Up to 10,000 rows per export. If your data exceeds this limit, the export will not include the rows beyond 10,000 (confirm with the product team how over-limit exports are handled before publishing).

Q: When does this become available?
A: Scheduled exports launch on November 4.

Q: What should I know about the limits?
A: Exports are capped at 10,000 rows and are available in CSV and JSON only. If you need more rows or another format, plan for a separate export method.

Open items before publishing: confirm schedule options (frequency, timing, time zones), delivery method, retention of exported files, and behavior when the row limit is reached.
quality_notes: Built only from the supplied work packet; no external facts added.
Behavior when the 10,000-row limit is exceeded is not in the packet and is flagged for confirmation rather than stated as fact.
Schedule options, delivery, and file retention are not specified in the packet and are listed as open items.
Colleagues were not contacted; the packet was judged sufficient for a concise draft, but a product owner review is recommended before publishing.
